title: Declare git-tracked JSON the permanent canonical store
lead: Record the owner's decision that branch-local, cloneable, reviewable JSON stays authoritative. A database may only be a rebuildable cache, never a replacement state store.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** implementing a cache or database, importing sqlite, adding commands or schemas, implementing a merge driver, or changing worktree allocation behavior.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: The goals currently say a database backing may come later, while ARCHITECTURE.md and README identify JSON as authority. U11 explains why an external database would break branch, clone, PR-diff and sandbox locality. The owner explicitly adopted the canonical-JSON policy.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body: Roadmap goals/non-goals through slicer prose commands; ARCHITECTURE.md, README.md and relevant worktree guidance. No production source change is required.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- Review criteria: the goals no longer contain the database-backing TBD and explicitly identify git-tracked .slicer JSON as canonical.
- Architecture and user docs state any future database is checkout-local, gitignored, rebuildable from JSON, and never read back as authority; ~/.slicer is not a canonical state directory.
- Worktree guidance references s175, s185 and s191, correctly distinguishing the shipped allocation floor from pending handoff hints/next_id merging.
- Freshness check passes after the prose update; the diff contains documentation/tracking changes only, with no cache implementation, dependency, schema or command.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Use the slicer prose CLI to replace the goals' TBD with the explicit canonical-JSON decision. Keep the store small/file-based and coordination through git. Update ordinary docs to explain that any future database is a disposable projection living inside the checkout and cannot become authoritative; no home-directory state store is permitted by this design.

Name the branch/clone/review/byte-compare reasons and link the existing worktree roadmap items without claiming they are all shipped. Preserve the existing rule that generated output is never parsed back. An ignored future cache need not be implemented or pre-created now. Re-render tracking through the CLI; never edit tracking JSON or generated prose directly.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
Review the goals through slicer goals/prose reads and ordinary documentation diff, then run the full unittest suite, tracking check, and git diff --check. No new test mirroring documentation text is required.

Use the project's ignored TMPDIR for temporary test fixtures, and scoped
support.isolated_discovery only for fixtures that require outside-project
discovery. The repository acceptance commands, run against the implementation
checkout's code and state, are:

```sh
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t tests
PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m slicer check --json
git diff --check
```

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One reviewed documentation/tracking commit. Do not claim a database exists or is planned for implementation.
